name: Cascade Server
description: Server companion for the Cascade music player. Fetches lyrics (word-level karaoke from Kugou, synced and plain from LRCLIB) and stores them server-side so they are shared across all users, with more Cascade server features to come.
overview: Cascade's server companion: lyrics fetching and storage, and more.

versions.changelog: Renamed from Cascade Lyrics to Cascade Server. New routes under /CascadeServer; the old /CascadeLyrics and /Audio/{itemId}/CascadeLyrics routes still work.
